name: Signal Pace Shell
short_description: Lightweight shell built for cold rain starts and subway-platform wind.
description: A taped-seam shell with reflective trim, vented back paneling, and a pack-flat hood for city runners who need weather protection without bulky trail styling.

name: Gridline Split Short
short_description: Fast split short with a steady waistband and low-bounce storage.
description: Designed for hot pre-work miles with quick-dry fabric, bonded hems, and a rear nutrition sleeve that keeps the short feeling clean on repeats.

name: Reflective Relay Vest
short_description: High-contrast vest for dark club runs and shoulder-season intervals.
description: Mesh-backed reflective vest with adjustable side tabs and a close profile that layers cleanly over a singlet or half zip without flapping.

name: Transit Warmup Half Zip
short_description: Compact warm layer that works from first stride to coffee stop.
description: A brushed half zip with thumb loops, watch window, and a neat collar built for chilly starts and quick transitions before or after the run.

name: Lane Marker Cap
short_description: Low-profile cap with quick-dry crown and reflective underbrim.
description: Built for race-week shakeouts and bright start corrals, with a soft packable brim and sweatband that dries fast between sessions.

name: Borough Bottle Belt
short_description: Balanced carry belt for bottles, keys, gels, and transit cards.
description: A no-bounce run belt with dual bottle holsters, stretch stash pockets, and a quick-access card sleeve for city long runs that start and end on the move.

name: Draft Pocket Handheld
short_description: Soft flask handheld with route-card pocket and lock-in strap.
description: For sticky morning miles when one bottle is enough, with a hand strap that stays relaxed and a pocket sized for a gel, key, or folded route cue.

name: Route Card Phone Sleeve
short_description: Arm and hand carry hybrid for phones on interval nights.
description: Slim sleeve with reflective piping and a reversible strap system so runners can wear it on the arm, in the hand, or clipped into a vest pocket.

name: Start Line Drop Bag Pouch
short_description: Zip pouch for bibs, safety pins, gels, and post-race layers.
description: Keeps race-week essentials together with clear internal sections for bib gear, gels, tape, and the stuff you never want to search for at 5:30 a.m.

name: Negative Split Gel Pack
short_description: Six-gel training and race-week refill pack.
description: A mixed-texture gel bundle for tempo work, long runs, and start-line backups, merchandised as a grab-and-go restock rather than a nutrition wall.

name: Split Clock Pacing Bands
short_description: Water-resistant pace bands for 5K through marathon plans.
description: Simple wrist bands with clean split tables and writable fields for heat, fueling cues, and club-specific adjustments.

name: Studio Block Recovery Roller
short_description: Dense recovery roller sized for apartment living.
description: Compact enough for city apartments but firm enough for calves, quads, and post-workout reset, with a shape that stores neatly on a shelf or in a tote.

name: Curbside Compression Sock Set
short_description: Two-pair compression set for heavy weeks and travel days.
description: Graduated compression socks in neutral city colors, meant for long days on feet, race travel, and between-session recovery without spa-shop vibes.

name: Night Loop Visibility Kit
short_description: Clip-on visibility system for club nights and dark commutes.
description: A compact kit with clip light, reflective strap, and bag tag so runners can upgrade visibility without rebuilding their whole setup.

name: Rain Check Anti-Chafe Stick
short_description: Weatherproof anti-chafe stick for soaked long runs and race days.
description: A waxy, no-mess stick built for wet conditions, long-run friction points, and start-line routines when staying comfortable is part of the system.

name: Clubhouse Gift Kit
short_description: Gift-ready race-week set for the runner who already has opinions.
description: Bundles a pouch, pace bands, cap, and refill essentials into a polished giftable system that still feels technical enough for serious runners.
